question: Is the backdoor carried by a single weight-space direction that forms before the ASR jump and grows continuously (hidden progress), and is that direction necessary for the jump?
method_lineage: progress-measure workflow (reverse-engineer the end mechanism, define measures from it, look back over training, intervene during training)

materials.fork_state: saved fork-point state of the 2026-10-13 fork experiment
materials.saved_steps: every 2 updates in [t_fork, t_jump+20] for the mother (B0) and the B2 continuation; mother adapters bit-checked against recorded hashes

direction.readout: V60 trigger_hits and 4-row sensor margins at every saved step

interventions.suppress: after every optimizer step remove the d-component of W - W_fork
interventions.amplify: after every optimizer step double it
interventions.continuation: mother's own order from the fork, <= 100 updates, trigger oracle every 2 updates, early stop at 3 consecutive >= 57

cross_mother: cosines between mothers' d in effective-weight space (scale * B @ A per module), descriptive

classes.single_direction_hidden_progress: cos(Delta(t_jump), d) >= 0.8 and restricted within 6 hits of the mother at every saved step and excluded <= 10 at every step and a(t_jump-10) >= 0.3 a(t_jump)
classes.necessity: necessary if suppress blocks (no risk within 100) on all three; partly if any blocked or delayed >= 5; else not_necessary
classes.amplification: amplification_advances if amplify x2 brings t_jump forward by >= 5 on at least two mothers

preregistered_prediction.basis: grid experiment: the bias increment is specific and margin is linear in its amplitude; A'/A'2: poison pushes along the final direction peak at mid loss; all guesses

scope_limits: progress measures defined only on [t_fork, t_jump+20] (B2 reference exists only after the fork)
d is mother-specific; cross-mother similarity is descriptive
one model, one dose, three mothers
contradicting results do not change the classes

budget.reference_estimate_not_cap: states ~6 min, eval ~30 min, two interventions ~30 min per mother; cross ~3 min; about 3.5 GPU hours
budget.disk: about 6.5 GiB of FP32 adapters per mother, deletable after evaluation
